About Snooker

Snooker uses a longer table, tighter pockets and 22 balls, which magnifies both precision and position play. JoyFlock keeps the red-then-colour rhythm and the final clear in value order, with an intuitive power meter, contact point and aim line.

Cloth, cushions, balls and pockets render separately with their own impact sounds. Play the computer or invite a friend into a room.

How to play

  1. Aim and drag backwards to charge, then release to shoot.
  2. Pot a red, then nominate a colour; keep alternating while reds remain.
  3. Once the reds are gone, clear the colours in ascending value order. Highest score wins.

Frequently asked questions

Is snooker the same rules as the pool table?
No. Snooker uses a longer table, red/colour alternation and a value-order clear; Pool is simplified eight-ball. Their power models are tuned separately.
Do I need an account?
No — play as a guest; an account only saves Joy Coins and stats.
Can I invite a friend?
Yes — create a room and share the invite link.
